16: For the school login, use the institution’s Canvas URL or its web page; contact the site administrator if credentials are unknown. To reset a self-created account’s password, choose Forgot Password, enter the login information, select Request Password and follow the email, then return to sign in. A parent observer uses the institution’s URL and links to the student with a pairing code generated from the student’s User Settings. A used pairing code or one older than seven days requires a new code; pairing codes are case-sensitive, entered without spaces and for the same institution.
17: Parents and other non-teachers can sign up for a Free Canvas account; it does not include all institutional features. Instructors can create courses, add students and deliver content. Students can access coursework, collaborate and view grades. Parents can participate as observers. The instructor provides the join code separately from the course invitation; if the code is missing, contact the instructor or institution. Help for a Free for Teacher account is in the Canvas Community FAQ.
